2026-11-24.summary:
\[Highlight start\] Vantage Data Centers' MXP2 Milan II campus in Castelletto, Italy, is a €350 million \($407 million USD\) development delivering 32 MW of critical IT capacity, with its first phase scheduled to be operational in spring 2026 \[Highlight end\] . [0]

### Capacity & Spatial Details

- IT Capacity: 32 MW of critical IT capacity across two modern data centres.
- Footprint: Approximately 10,000 m² \(108,000 sq ft\) of building space.
- Broader Context: Combined with the MXP1 campus, Vantage's total critical IT capacity in Italy reaches 96 MW. The broader multi\-campus investment across Italy is recognized as a national strategic investment under Article 13 of Decree Law 104/2023. [0]

### Financial & Investment
